title: Sumatran tigers
text:
The Sumatran tiger is the smallest tiger in the world. It lives only on the island of Sumatra in Indonesia. Its orange fur has thick, dark stripes that are closer together than the stripes of other tigers. The stripes help it hide in the long grass and in the shadows of the forest.

Sumatran tigers hunt alone, mostly at night. They eat deer, wild pigs and other animals. A tiger can jump a long way and swim well. Unlike many cats, tigers like water, and they often cool down in rivers during the hot day.

Sadly, there are very few Sumatran tigers left in the wild. People have cut down much of the forest where they live, so the tigers have less food and less space. Some people also hunt tigers, which is against the law.

Rangers now watch the forests and help to protect the tigers. Scientists put hidden cameras in the trees to count them and learn where they go. If we keep the forests safe, these beautiful animals have a chance to live on.
